brief: Make scene paintovers first, then implement toward the ideal. Preserve gameplay route and player camera.

main.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production art-direction paintover of an actual 3D platform game screenshot, wide 16:10 landscape.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current "Nightworks After Hours" gameplay arrival view.
Primary request: Re-art-direct this weak scene into an exceptional, cohesive, grand volcanic night quarry. Keep the same third-person camera, player at bottom centre on the circular checkpoint, exact walkable platforms, gaps, route sequence, torches, pickups and HUD positions. Change the ENVIRONMENT ART, SURFACES AND LIGHTING, not the level layout.
Dominant distant subject: one enormous, believable broad stratovolcano with an asymmetrical collapsed caldera and heavy sculpted basalt shoulders, rising above the playable route in the upper centre-left. It feels kilometres wide. No collection of needle mountains. Three to five distinctly separate sinuous branching rivers of molten scarlet with slender orange-hot cores descend through carved channels from the glowing crater, gathering into pools far below. Lava occupies a small fraction of the mountain, sharply legible against massive dark basalt. Cool ash-blue moonlight describes the rock ridges. A broad ash plume above the crater is lit dull crimson underneath and disappears into layered indigo clouds. A distant low cloud bank cuts across the lower slope to establish monumental scale.
Composition: retain the exact foreground route silhouette. Replace the flat brown boxes with chunky weathered Nightworks quarry slabs: muted desaturated slate/umber top faces, clean readable edges, large subtle chisel seams and irregular stratified broken stone underneath. The platforms extend toward the volcano. Beneath and around them is a deep natural caldera basin, with layered, irregular black basalt cliffs and pillars at multiple distances. A dark crusted lava lake lies far below, only parts visible through gaps; broad calm dark rafts, separated flowing orange-red currents, soft warm haze and shoreline glow. No repeating neon crack texture, no rectangular carpet of lava. Do not add landings to any gameplay gaps.
Lighting: sophisticated restrained cinematic game lighting, readable cool foreground plane, warm torch pools, subtle red reflected underlight on lower rocks, strong value separation between foreground/midground/far volcano. The focal lava channels are bright but not flat clipped red paint. Deep blue-grey and plum shadows, cool silver-blue edges, hot red-orange in small deliberate accents. Atmosphere with depth, not a flat navy void.
Style: polished authored stylized 3D game environment, tactile stone, excellent broad shape hierarchy, similar to a modern high-quality fantasy platformer; no photorealistic fine noise, no illustration brush marks, no visual clutter, no text labels or captions. The output should be an achievable in-game art target. Preserve character, props, platforms and UI placement.

bonus.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production environment paintover for a 3D platform game's side-view bonus stage.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, current bonus gameplay. Input image 2 is the approved working ART-DIRECTION REFERENCE for the main level, showing the desired volcano, quarry materials, night lighting and lava-basin depth.
Primary request: Rebuild the environment art in image 1 to match the sophisticated composition and material quality in image 2. Preserve the same close side camera, standing character at the same screen position, exact flat walkable foreground shelf silhouette, bouncing crate position, pickups, torch and all HUD positions. Keep the game layout intact.
Background: replace the silly small spiky mountain with the same unimaginably large broad stratovolcano from image 2, kilometres away, framed behind the character and shifted slightly right so its crater and lava branching remain visible. Its broad asymmetric shoulders extend beyond the frame. Distinct narrow red-orange lava channels follow erosion valleys down heavy ash-blue basalt ridges. A fractured caldera glows at the summit. Layered crimson-lit ash above, cool clouds behind and a pale mist bank across the lower shoulders. Convey immensity and distance rather than a nearby prop. No crown of needles, no broad painted red stripes.
Below the foreground shelf, show a vast caldera basin with layered dark cliffs, natural columnar basalt, high rock islands and a deep crusted lava lake. Calm broad dark cooled rafts with rivers of hot orange-red between them; restrained red haze. The lake must read as a real landscape with a shoreline, not a flat repeating texture or rectangular pool. Some near foreground basalt in the lower corners, mid-distance shelves, vast distant volcano. Do not fill any gameplay gaps.
Foreground platform surface becomes tactile cool grey weathered slate with broad cracks and warm ember light grazing its lip, large chipped irregular stone sides. Keep the top playable and clear. Apply restrained cool moonlit edges to the character and props, warm torch glow and red bounced light beneath. Maintain bright readable character and crate silhouette.
Style: polished stylized real-time 3D fantasy platformer, coherent with image 2. Strong cinematic value hierarchy, deep blue-plum shadows, finely controlled bright lava accents and warm gold torchlight. No photoreal fine noise, no painterly brush marks, no new gameplay props, no added labels. Same landscape frame as image 1.

panorama.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ultra-wide panoramic distant environment matte used on a curved sky backdrop in a real-time 3D game. 3:1 landscape composition, target 3840 by 1280 pixels.
Input image 1 is ART-DIRECTION REFERENCE ONLY, the approved main-level concept. Generate a clean landscape asset in exactly that style. Exclude EVERY foreground game element: no platforms, bridge, props, torches, character, pickups, UI, typography, logos.
Primary subject: the monumental broad stratovolcano from the reference. Frame the COMPLETE immense mountain, from its foothills to its summit, at centre of the panorama. Its width occupies 55 percent of the total image width and summit stands at 30 percent image height measured from top. A broad asymmetric collapsed caldera with heavy basalt shoulders, dominant long ridges, individually sculpted ravines. Three distinct narrow branching channels of molten scarlet with tiny hot orange cores descend naturally through eroded valleys from crater to the far basin. Dark volcanic rock accounts for 95 percent of the mountain surface. Lava is beautifully luminous without featureless blown-out areas.
Distant ground: a vast black basalt caldera landscape spans the bottom quarter of image, layered low plateaus and far pinnacles behind one another, subtle red haze in the valleys. The bottom edge is very dark ash-plum haze with NO brightly cut-off lava river. A long pale ash mist band crosses the volcano lower shoulders, occluding some foothills and establishing an immense scale.
Sky: expansive deep blue-violet night sky above, sophisticated silver blue ash clouds and a large swirling eruption plume with dull red illumination underneath. A small partially clouded moon on the upper far right. At both far left and right, the scene fades into quieter dark distant mountains under diffuse matching cool clouds, so both edges are dark and unobtrusive. No bright stars.
Style and palette: match reference's sophisticated authored 3D fantasy game environment; broad readable shapes and carved surface details, strong atmospheric depth, coherent cool moonlit rock, restrained orange-red molten light, cinematographic composition. This is a background painting with only distant scenery, no near rocks or walkable surfaces at all. No fisheye or panorama distortion. No border.

lake.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless square top-down albedo/emission texture for a large volcanic lava lake in a real-time stylized 3D game, matching the reference's dark crusted lava basin.
Reference image 1 gives the desired art direction only. Produce ONLY the lava lake surface viewed exactly perpendicular from above, no surrounding scenery.
Across the square are broad dark cooled basalt rafts of widely varying sizes, rough ropy wrinkled surfaces and irregular flowing shorelines. About 82 percent dark cooled crust and 18 percent visible flowing magma. Three major lazy branching currents of deep molten scarlet with slender orange-gold hottest cores meander among those rafts. A few small secondary dark-red fissures join the currents. Current widths vary naturally. Use large calm dark shapes with intricate ropy detail inside, not tiny equally sized pebbles and not a uniform crack grid. Hot streaks align along the flowing currents. Restrained ember red glow on raft edges. Rich natural material variation, sophisticated painterly 3D texture without brush strokes. Palette of deep charcoal, slate violet, subdued maroon, scarlet and sparse gold-orange. No pure white hot areas. No big baked glow halos or directional light.
This is an orthographic MATERIAL swatch, no perspective, no horizon, no landscape features, no volcano, no objects, no text, no frame, no vignette. Tile seamlessly across every edge. Surface fills the entire square.
